stemMarkdown: A rectangular garden 30 m by 15 m is surrounded by a path 3 m wide running all around it on the outside. Find the area (in square m) of the path.
solutionMarkdown: The outer rectangle measures $36$ m by $21$ m, an area of $756$ square m. Subtracting the garden's $450$ square m leaves $306$.
altSolutionMarkdown: The path widens the plot on both sides, so each dimension grows by twice the width.
